address: 36 Phan Tu Street, My An Ward, Ngu Hanh Son District, Da Nang, 550000, Vietnam
bio: This stall sells all things duck. Duck porridge is made with rice and mung beans in a duck broth. Poached duck boasts firm, flavourful meat. When tossed with green mango, green banana, fig and herbs, it makes a refreshing salad....
